in_marathi.name: Devkishan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's grace, god-gifted
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devkishan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devkishan is derived from two Sanskrit words: ‘Deva’ meaning god and ‘Kishan’ meaning grace, gift, or god-gifted. The name signifies the divine grace and blessings bestowed by the gods upon an individual.
